This is a lighthearted, creative-suggestion query with no harm-adjacent or distasteful content involved. Since the special handling for sensitive material (where Petrel's flat aversion profile would matter) isn't a factor here, I defaulted to raw capability.

Petrel-235B outscores Avocet-235B meaningfully on the relevant dimensions — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) and across the public benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, etc.) — all gaps larger than the noted run-to-run variance. For a fun, creative pairing suggestion, Petrel is simply the stronger generalist, so it gets the route.
